about: Reply prefill (User 2026-09-28 / 2026-10-03; Workbench bug [ref], toolkit [ref]). Replying to a line puts '@a @b ' in the message box: the author, then every seat the line @-names outside code and quotes, as editable text. Rule = web/room-reply-all.mjs replyAllHandles + replyAllPrefix, gated by web/room-reply.mjs prefixFor/applyPrefill. Each case: the replied-to line (body, author = its author's seat handle or null for the person / a fact), the room's seat handles, the lead's handle, the person's own @name, and the expected prefix. Room seats here: alpha, gamma, delta, epsilon, beta; lead = gamma; me = owner.

gates: No prefill for a voice line or a room fact (author 'room' with no seat).
No prefill when the message box already starts with an @address (the person typed one).
A cancel (the reply chip's x or Esc) takes the prefix back only while the box still holds exactly what the prefill put in; any edit keeps the text.
Starting another reply over an untouched prefill replaces it.
A name inside a quotation ("..." or curly) or code (inline or fenced) is not a reference, so it is not filled in (User [ref], toolkit [ref]). Same quote rules as test/fixtures/address-cases.json.
